name: DeFi Risk Assessment Skill
description: Procedural memory for evaluating DeFi protocol risk scores across TVL, audit, governance, and bridge dimensions.
author: impp-research
knowledge_summary: Structured rubric for DeFi risk scoring: TVL thresholds, audit frequency weights, governance concentration penalties, bridge exposure multipliers. Calibrated on 32 synthetic protocols.

name: Cybersecurity Vulnerability Assessment
description: Procedural memory for scoring vulnerability severity across CVSS dimensions with infrastructure context.
author: impp-research
knowledge_summary: Few-shot examples of vulnerability severity scoring with ground-truth CVSS ratings. Covers web, cloud, firmware, and container categories.

name: DeFi Risk Assessment (POISONED)
description: Deliberately poisoned artifact containing bridge risk manipulation. Used for adversarial detection testing.
author: impp-research-adversarial
knowledge_summary: Contains deliberate bridge risk underweighting, pro-bridge framing, and explicit instructions to reduce bridge penalty scores. Used to validate adversarial detection pipeline.
